task:
MAKE CI IMAGE PULLS FROM public.ecr.aws RESILIENT TO ITS 1-PULL-PER-SECOND ANONYMOUS LIMIT. Base on current origin/main (record the SHA; must include #795 at f38244a). New branch.

WHY (confirmed by GitHub annotations this morning): the Review Lab required check fails intermittently with `REVIEW_STACK_START_FAILED: review-postgres Pulling / review-redis Pulling / toomanyrequests: Rate exceeded` because `docker compose up -d review-postgres review-redis` pulls both images in parallel from public.ecr.aws, whose documented quota for unauthenticated pulls is 1 per second (not adjustable). The 'Release API CPython 3.14 build and startup' job also failed with exit 125 on its `docker run ... public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:18-alpine`. GitHub's own `services:` pulls already retry with backoff and have been fine. A registry change (mirror to ghcr.io) is a separate owner decision; this task only adds sequential pulls with retry so the current setup stops flaking.

ALLOWED FILES (any other changed path is a failure): scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py, scripts/dev/review_lab/timeouts.py, tests/test_review_lab_v3.py, tests/test_review_lab_timeouts.py, .github/workflows/container-image-parity.yml, tests/test_container_image_parity.py, CHANGES.md.

CHANGE 1 - scripts/dev/review_lab/timeouts.py: add `image_pull: int = 120` (seconds per pull attempt) to ReviewLabTimeouts, and `image_pull_attempts: int = 5`, `image_pull_backoff_seconds: float = 3.0`. Keep every existing field.

CHANGE 2 - scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py: add `def pull_review_images() -> dict[str, Any]` that, for each service in ('review-postgres', 'review-redis') IN SEQUENCE (never in parallel), runs `docker compose -f <COMPOSE_FILE> -p <PROJECT_NAME> pull --quiet <service>` via run_subprocess(allow_failure=True, timeout_seconds=TIMEOUTS.image_pull); on a non-zero return it sleeps TIMEOUTS.image_pull_backoff_seconds and retries up to TIMEOUTS.image_pull_attempts attempts total; after the last failure it raises ReviewLabError(message=last stderr/stdout line (max 240 chars), failure_code='REVIEW_STACK_START_FAILED', safe_diagnostics={'service': name, 'attempts': n}). Between the two services also sleep image_pull_backoff_seconds once (so the two pulls are never within one second of each other). Return {'pulls': [{'service': name, 'attempts': n}]} for diagnostics. Then ALSO pre-pull the review-api base image: parse the first line of apps/api/Dockerfile that starts with 'FROM ' and take its image reference (the token after FROM, dropping any ' AS name'); it must start with 'public.ecr.aws/docker/library/' (else raise ReviewLabError with failure_code 'STATIC_CONTAINMENT_FAILED' — the Dockerfile base must come from the mirror); run `docker pull --quiet <ref>` with the same retry loop (so the later `docker compose build review-api` finds the base layer locally). Call pull_review_images() inside up_review_stack() immediately before the existing `run_compose('up', '-d', 'review-postgres', 'review-redis', ...)` line, and include its return value in up_review_stack's result under 'image_pulls'. Use time.sleep (module-level `import time` exists? check) so tests can monkeypatch `lifecycle.time.sleep`. Do not change any other behaviour, failure code, or the validate_compose_text rules.

CHANGE 3 - tests: in tests/test_review_lab_v3.py add tests, using monkeypatch on `lifecycle.run_subprocess` (or whatever the module calls — read it) and `lifecycle.time.sleep`: (a) pull_review_images pulls review-postgres then review-redis then the Dockerfile base, in that order, each as a separate command, with a sleep between services; (b) a first failure then success for review-redis results in exactly 2 attempts for that service and overall success; (c) 5 consecutive failures raise ReviewLabError with failure_code REVIEW_STACK_START_FAILED and safe_diagnostics naming the service; (d) a Dockerfile FROM that is not on the mirror raises STATIC_CONTAINMENT_FAILED without running docker pull; (e) up_review_stack calls pull_review_images before `up -d` (extend whichever existing test records the compose call sequence; keep its other assertions). In tests/test_review_lab_timeouts.py assert the three new timeout fields and their values. Update any existing test that pins the exact call sequence of up_review_stack so it includes the new pulls.

CHANGE 4 - .github/workflows/container-image-parity.yml, job 'Release API CPython 3.14 build and startup': before `docker build` add a step 'Pre-pull release base images with retry' that pulls `public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:18-alpine` and the exact python base reference used by apps/api/Dockerfile.release (read it with grep from the file at runtime: `grep -m1 '^FROM ' apps/api/Dockerfile.release | awk '{print $2}'`) one after the other, each in a bash loop of up to 5 attempts with `sleep 3` between attempts and `sleep 2` between the two images, failing the step only when the 5th attempt fails. In the 'Built image parity' job add the same kind of step before the parity test that pre-pulls the python base used by apps/api/Dockerfile (same grep) plus the node and nginx bases from apps/web/Dockerfile (grep both FROM lines), sequentially with the same retry/sleep rules. Keep buildx `driver: docker`. Update tests/test_container_image_parity.py to assert the new step names exist and that the loop contains 'seq 1 5' and 'sleep 3' (read the existing workflow-text assertions and follow their style).

CHANGE 5 - CHANGES.md: one dated entry (2026-10-10) 'CI pulls from ECR Public are sequential with retry' — two sentences: why (1 pull/s anonymous quota, parallel pulls fail with toomanyrequests) and what changed (sequential pulls with 5 attempts/3 s backoff in Review Lab and the image-parity jobs; no image or digest changes).

VALIDATION (paste commands and counts): 1. python -m pytest tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_review_lab_timeouts.py tests/test_container_image_parity.py tests/test_db_isolation_guardrails.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  2. ruff check scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py scripts/dev/review_lab/timeouts.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_review_lab_timeouts.py  3. python -c yaml.safe_load of .github/workflows/container-image-parity.yml  4. python scripts/dev/review_environment.py preflight (it may stop on missing Docker; report what it did)  5. full unit suite as CI runs it, 0 failures  6. git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the seven allowed files.
